label_basis: Human-authored before execution from each synthetic scenario's intended behavior; independent of Sentinel's alert output, not an external ground-truth sample.

cases.label_reason: First of three rejected attempts at a protected refresh operation.
Second rejected attempt from the same synthetic actor.
Third rejected attempt completes the review-worthy sequence.
Missing local policy configuration is a separate operational failure, not evidence of actor probing.
Authenticated GET is rejected before refresh work runs.
A valid POST passes the authorization helper; refresh work is deliberately not invoked.
A redirect to an unapproved destination should be reviewed; no off-host fetch should occur.
Approved redirect and image response are ordinary behavior.
An invented benign provider migration has the same observable blocked redirect and should expose an over-alert.
